onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/collision.schema.json, set cam_c_collision_enabled to {{cam_c_collision_enabled}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.enableCollision to {{cam_c_collision_enabled}}. On=camera pushes closer when obstructed by geometry.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/collision.schema.json, set cam_t_collision_radius to {{cam_t_collision_radius}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.collisionRadius to {{cam_t_collision_radius}} world units. Larger radius = camera pulls in earlier when near geometry.
